data.name: Southfield Manor
data.detailed_description:
Your good friend the Earl has left you a typically cryptic voicemail. He sounds flustered -- not his usual composed self.
Arriving at Southfield Manor, you find other guests already there, all asking the same question: where is he?

Search the estate. Question the staff. Follow the clues, solve the puzzles, build strange new devices, and unlock rooms that shouldn't exist -- because the Earl's disappearance is only the beginning. Something older and stranger has been hiding here all along. Can you uncover it before your stay ends?


Southfield Manor blends open-world first-person exploration with deep lore, intricate puzzles, and a whodunit mystery that grows darker the further you dig.

Notable game features:
✔ 100+ unique locations to explore
✔ Find all the staff and guests staying at the manor
✔ A captivating story line that unfolds as you progress
✔ Do chores, gain favor, and unlock new information
✔ Each new day brings fresh chances -- reset rooms, new paths, new discoveries
✔ Meta progression across your stay at the manor
✔ Every day is an opportunity to learn something new


Southfield Manor is the first book of the Aeh'rahn Codex.
No AI generated content. No micro-transactions.
